entry.title: Fire at Indonesian candy factory leaves at least 3 dead and dozens of workers unaccounted for

media:group.media:title: Fire at Indonesian candy factory leaves at least 3 dead and dozens of workers unaccounted for
media:group.media:description:
A fire has swept through a candy factory in Indonesia’s Banten province, leaving at least three people dead and rescue teams searching for 36 workers who remained unaccounted for. Officials said the blaze broke out at the PT Fonusa Agung Mulia factory in Serang district, in Banten province, which borders Jakarta.

entry.title: Mexico detains top cartel boss 'El Chapo Isidro,' setting off a burst of violence in Sinaloa

media:group.media:title: Mexico detains top cartel boss 'El Chapo Isidro,' setting off a burst of violence in Sinaloa
media:group.media:description:
Gunfire rang out, trucks burned and Mexican forces clashed with cartel gunmen in the state of Sinaloa overnight as Mexican authorities captured cartel boss Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, known as “El Chapo Isidro.". Meza Flores was one of the FBI’s 10 most wanted fugitives, who climbed the cartel ranks to lead the Beltrán Leyva cartel and later became the leader of his own group, the Meza-Flores criminal organization. (AP Video shot by Ararak Salomón and Amaranta Marentes. Produced by Karen Chammas and Leo La Valle)
